# Block Catalog — AI Authoring

Every registered block, the description a model sees when authoring it, and the **authoring mode** that governs how the AI may create it. The model-facing text is the block's `aiHint` when present (✎), otherwise its human tooltip `description`.

**51** registered · **48** authorable · **3** deferred · **15** calibrated with an aiHint · 1 non-literal-type placeholder(s) skipped.

**Authoring modes** — `full` (model writes all attrs) · `container` (full + nested child blocks, Phase 2) · `seed` (inserted empty; payload supplied later) · `reference` (points at existing content) · `computed` (config only; block derives content) · `⏸ deferred` (needs a bespoke tool; not yet authorable). Policy lives in [`lib/domain/blocks/ai-authoring.ts`](../../../../lib/domain/blocks/ai-authoring.ts).
